description: A lab-local stored XSS fixture: a comment containing a script tag is rendered unescaped.

evidence.response: 200 OK, comment stored with raw <script> tag

impact: An attacker could execute script in another lab user's browser session.
proof_of_concept: POST /comments {"body": "<script>alert(1)</script>"} returns 200; response page contains the raw script tag.
remediation: Encode comment output on render and enforce a content security policy.
steps_to_reproduce: Submit a comment containing <script>alert(1)</script> on https://lab.local/comments
Reload the comments page as another lab user
Observe the script executing in the lab browser
title: Stored XSS in lab comment field
